policy.causal_rule: No price causality is inferred from an announcement, account ratio, stablecoin balance, ETF tracker or CI pass alone. Separate observed facts from hypotheses and keep features excluded until quality gates pass.

edges.claim: A single Binance dashboard reports price weakness, positive funding and long-heavy account positioning; it is not a market-wide notional exposure measure.
A five-fund tracker reports +$90.4M over 30 sessions, zero flow on Oct 28 and -$3.6M on Oct 26; issuer-level reconciliation is missing.
Coinbase reported $20B average USDC held in its products in Q2 2026 and broad revenue diversification; this does not measure XRP inflows.
Coinbase Q3 results are scheduled after market close on Oct 29; this is a monitoring event only until results are published and XRP-specific causal pathways are measured.
Circle's Q3 results are scheduled for Nov 4 at 8:00 a.m. ET; future financial metrics and any XRP impact are unknown at this cutoff.
Main signal timestamp is 13:23:33 UTC, score 44, confidence 0.0; at 15:58 UTC it is about 154 minutes old and lacks explicit forecast metadata.
PR #1337 adds strict sentiment parsing, timestamp/weight validation and explicit NOT_ISSUED metadata. Exact-head CI and gate passed, but the draft PR is not active on main.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Long-biased account positioning may create liquidation sensitivity during continued spot weakness.
disconfirming_evidence: Single venue and account ratios are not notional exposure
No synchronized cross-venue spot or liquidation panel

competing_hypotheses.claim: Positive cumulative ETF flow may coexist with weak near-term marginal demand.
disconfirming_evidence: Tracker methodology and issuer holdings are unreconciled
Daily zero rows may not represent complete settlement

competing_hypotheses.claim: Coinbase/Circle stablecoin and payments expansion may be complementary to some XRP corridors or may compete with XRP bridge use, but neither effect is measured here.
disconfirming_evidence: No issuer-specific XRP collateral or execution data
Stablecoin balances are not equivalent to XRP demand
